title: The Unquiet Confession
author: Yara Lockridge
blurb: Orsen Halloran, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
